description: Unit test class for the Basket entity, testing behaviors of adding items, quantity updates, and error handling in the Basket aggregate.

classes.name: BasketAddItem
classes.description: Test class verifying the behavior of adding items to the Basket entity, including quantity updates and error handling.

methods.name: AddsBasketItemIfNotPresent
methods.description: Tests adding a new item to the basket when the item is not already present.

methods.name: IncrementsQuantityOfItemIfPresent
methods.description: Tests that adding an existing item increases its quantity.

methods.name: KeepsOriginalUnitPriceIfMoreItemsAdded
methods.description: Ensures the unit price remains unchanged when additional items are added with the same catalog item.

methods.name: DefaultsToQuantityOfOne
methods.description: Verifies that adding an item without specifying quantity defaults to 1.

methods.name: CantAddItemWithNegativeQuantity
methods.description: Checks that adding an item with negative quantity throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: CantModifyQuantityToNegativeNumber
methods.description: Checks that modifying an existing item's quantity to a negative number throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException.
